game.name: Culdcept Saga (Japan)(Title Update-ban)
game.desc: Culdcept Saga is a strategic role-playing game for Xbox 360. Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where wars have ravaged the world. Your role is to stop these wars using your abilities to control powerful monsters and summon powerful entities through mystical cards. Over 500 cards and summonses are available to unlock for unforgettable battles.
